Health Checks and Restart Policy

Health checks assess service availability or readiness; restart policies recover exited processes
under configured rules.
Health check එක service එක Jහාඳින් වැඩ කරනවද බලනවා. Readiness traffic ගන්න පුළුවන්ද
බලනවා. Restart policy එක process exit වුණාම නැවත start කළ හැකියි.
A router sends traffic only to healthy API instances.

Expected result: curl succeeds for a valid successful response; restart policy is separate.
Does a Docker unhealthy status automatically restart a container?
Not by itself in ordinary Docker; restart policy reacts to process exit.
Remember: Health observes; restart responds to exit.
